# content_hash may raise on non-JSON-serializable payloads

content_hash calls json.dumps on the given payload without handling TypeError or providing serialization hooks; if the payload contains non-JSON-serializable objects, json.dumps will raise and there is no fallback or validation in this module.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/ir.py` — `knowledge_compiler.ir.content_hash`
